verdict.rationale: An AI writing assistant in the composer is a fair question for an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never mentions AI drafting or refining subject lines or copy. The nearby features are different capabilities: automatic brand-coloured design generation, and dynamic personalisation of subject lines from subscriber data. Neither generates copy from a brief, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer
